title: The Complete Guide to NYC Co-op Renovation
meta_description: Everything about renovating a NYC co-op: alteration agreements, board approval, costs, timeline.
excerpt: Everything you need to know about renovating a NYC co-op apartment, from alteration agreements through construction.
body:
What Makes Co-op Renovation Different

The board. Before any construction, your plan must be approved through a formal alteration agreement. This adds 4-8 weeks before a hammer swings.

The Process

Package Preparation: Scope, plans, insurance certificates, contractor credentials. Board Submission: Via managing agent. Board Review: Typically at monthly meetings. May approve, approve with conditions, or request modifications. Scheduling: Coordinate with super for start dates, elevator reservations, floor protection.

Cost Impact

Budget 15-25% more than comparable non-co-op work. Restricted hours, elevator scheduling, and protection requirements all add cost. Full co-op renovations: $55,000-$400,000. Contact us for a specific estimate.
